move: veil slides off hero, serif lines rise, words cascade, veil closes
how: A paper-coloured veil over the hero image scales x 1→0 from the right (expo.inOut 0.9s) while the hero rises from y 60 and its image Ken Burns from scale 1.12 / yPercent -3 to 1 / +3 linearly over the whole duration. A black pill tag grows scaleX from 0 at its left edge (expo.out) and its orange dot pops with back.out(3). Three serif headline lines rise masked from yPercent 110 with a 3° rotation from the top-left corner (expo.out, stagger 0.12); the excerpt's words (split into spans) cascade y 18→0 with opacity, stagger 0.035; a short rule scales x from 0, meta text slides in, a CTA rises with back.out(1.6) and a brand line fades. The CTA arrow nudges x 10 yoyo ×3 from 60%. Exit at 84%: headline lines exit upward with expo.in (stagger 0.06), the other blocks fade up, and the veil scales back to 1 from the left with expo.in.
adapt: Replace the hero image, tag text, three headline lines, excerpt, meta, CTA label and brand, and the paper/orange colours; keep the 0.9s veil wipe and the 0.12s line stagger with the 3° rotation.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the hero with veil, tag, title rows, splits the excerpt into .w spans, and adds meta/CTA/brand; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with veil at 0.01D, lines at 0.175D, words at 0.31D, nudge 0.6-0.8D, exit at 0.84D. All from() tweens need immediateRender:false; selectors el-scoped.
